cfe_lead: How JGates runs the checks in this repository. These are project rules: they apply to everyone and live in jgates.yml.
cfe_governed_reason: Governed mode: execution is fixed by the policy {policy} and does not change here.
cfe_h_runner: Where tools run when they do not choose: on this machine or in a container.
cfe_h_concurrency: How many stages run at the same time.
cfe_h_network: Explicit: the plan shows which checks use the network. Allowed: they may run with network. Denied: the plan is blocked if any of them needs network.
cfe_h_failFast: When a stage fails, the rest is recorded as not run.
cfe_h_timeoutSeconds: Limit of each stage before it is interrupted.
cfe_h_budgets.totalSeconds: Time limit of a whole validation.
cfe_h_budgets.memoryMegabytes: Memory limit of each tool process.
cfe_h_budgets.processes: Limit of tool processes at the same time.
cfe_h_budgets.logMegabytes: Limit of the space the logs of a validation may take.
cfe_not_applied: Declared, not applied by the engine yet
cfe_retention_note: Retention of stored validations belongs to each person's data folder, not to the repository.
